result.topic_en: Notes on hyperelliptic (p-dimensional) curve theory: counting coefficients and arbitrary constants of adjoint functions φ of various orders (2p-6, 2p-5, 2p-4, ..., 2p-3+m) vanishing at Wendepunkte/contact points, and quotients of determinants of such functions expressed through theta functions, with characteristic tables of 0/1 triples at the top.
